update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.56 - Support card data fix, umapyoi cross-validation, manual game-data refresh
New --- - Added a "Manually Refresh Game Data" option under Settings → Data Management that opens the GitHub Actions page for the game-data scraper, so support card stats/types can be refreshed on demand instead of waiting for the weekly automatic run. - The game-data scraper now cross-validates each support card's type and rarity against umapyoi.net's independently-sourced data and logs a warning on any mismatch, to catch bad scrapes before they reach the app.
Fixes ----- - Removed fabricated support card data: a nonexistent "Gold Ship (Guts)" variant and incorrect type overrides for Gold Ship, Grass Wonder, Matikanefukukitaru, and Symboli Rudolf were overriding the real scraped data and corrupting deck recommendation labels, friend-borrow scoring, and deck-fit scoring.
